decision.msg: Item 1, cause of the 'second boot': there was no second Servex. sustain.log (UTC) 22:32:37 'Servex is back as pid 32996', 22:33:56 'Servex 32996 exited (3221226505) after 85s — restarting in 1s', 22:33:57 'Servex up as pid 35816'. servex.jsonl (local) 17:33:56 helper-spawn-always-task registered by pid 32996, 17:33:59 dispatcher registered by pid 35816, 17:34:01 revive sweep resumed the helper. Exit 3221226505 = 0xC0000409, a native fast-fail; sustain.log holds 53 such exits and no node report exists for this one. So the keeper restarted a crashed Servex and the new boot's revive() swept an agent born 5 s earlier. Fix: revive() guarded once per process (Agents.revived), and Servex.only_one() in index.js refuses a second Servex on the same port with one line BEFORE the constructor touches the shared registry (before this, a second process ran revive() and wrote the registry, then died on EADDRINUSE with a stack trace; tested on the private port 18091). The 0xC0000409 crash itself is not fixed (alternative: a Windows WER/crash dump trace; larger, needs the owner's machine). Commit 6dcdc47f3.

Item 2: Server/clarity.mjs is fenced out (Server/), so the opt-out is in Agents.default_task: a spawn with role reviewer/clarity/checker (ONE_PASS) gets no default task dir, same as task:false. Alternative considered: log into the helper task they review; rejected because the clarity skill writes to flags.jsonl and reviewers to the reviewed task's review.md, so they have no output of their own. Reviewers (Server/review.mjs, owner-check.mjs) were noise the same way. Proved on a private Servex: a helper got spawned/helper-h-check, a clarity spawn got no dir, and Server/State.mjs listed the helper only. Commit 0ab5016c1.

log.msg: Bare minion on the private Servex (SERVEX_HOME /tmp/sx-home-3, port 18091): agent log has result ok:true and no 'restarted mid-turn' line; servex.jsonl has exactly one revive line. revive-guard-proof 21/24 fails identically on the main tree (before this change).

assign.outcome: Both fixes merged to michael/dev (6dcdc47f3, 0ab5016c1; todo strike ae492c45e). The second boot was the keeper restarting a Servex that crashed with exit 0xC0000409 (53 such exits in sustain.log), not a double launch; revive() now runs once per process and a second Servex on the same port refuses with one line before touching the registry. One-pass roles (clarity, reviewer, checker) get no default task dir. Private-Servex checks passed (bare minion result ok:true with no restart line; no clarity dir; State lists the helper only). The 0xC0000409 crash itself is unfixed. The live Servex still runs the old code: the mastermind must restart it (I did not).
